attchmntText: Asian Hotels (East) Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- New
voiceSummary: Asian Hotels East Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board noted a limited review report from M/s Singhi & Co. The auditor issued a qualified conclusion due to non-recognition of impairment provisions for investments in subsidiary GJS Hotels Limited, citing a Government of Odisha order directing vacation of property and invocation of a Rs. 350 lakhs bank guarantee. The auditor stated that recognizing impairment would increase expenses by Rs. 1,344.50 lakhs, reducing net profit to Rs. 828.30 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 298.32 lakhs for the half year. The company reported a net profit of Rs. 516.20 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 1,046.18 lakhs for the half year. India Ratings and Research assigned an IND BBB+/Stable rating to Rs. 165 crores in bank loan facilities. The Board also noted an emphasis of matter regarding recoverability of Rs. 25,713.83 lakhs invested in subsidiary Novak Hotels Private Limited, dependent on the acquisition of Hyatt Regency Mumbai.
